messages:
oliver.design: dropping a fresh mock for the latency/throughput panel — focusing on compact-row behavior. main question: should the sampling control live inline under the heatmap scrubber (one-click) or be tucked into the kebab menu (cleaner toolbar)? :mag:

neha.eng: my instinct = inline is more discoverable. downside: in compact it eats toolbar space and shifts the time scrubber left by ~40px. also more interactive elements = more diffing on update.

rachel.pm: from user interviews: engineers expect quick toggles next to charts. they asked repeatedly if sampling changes p95 or just visualization. we need explicit copy.

drew.a11y: accessibility first: whatever we choose must have clear aria labels and keyboard flow. suggestions: aria-label=\"Toggle chart sampling\" for toggle button; if it's a flyout, set role=dialog and trap focus, return focus to the source control on close. Also ensure contrast for the p95 pill on dark backgrounds (current purple #6f5ad0 on #0f0f12 fails AA).

neha.eng: back-end note: we currently only store a single `dashboard_sampling_level`. supporting per-chart sampling requires adding `chart_id` + `sampling_level` to the prefs store and a migration. perf prototype shows ~25ms extra per panel render when we read per-chart prefs in the React tree.

oliver.design: to meet discoverability & perf tradeoffs, propose a hybrid: show a tiny inline icon (funnel) beside the scrubber. clicking it opens a small flyout anchored to the chart with: 1) On/Off toggle, 2) Sample rate slider (5-100), 3) a short help line saying where the toggle applies (e.g., \"applies to: Heatmap\"). default flyout state collapsed.

rachel.pm: microcopy suggestion for the flyout help: option A: \"Sampling reduces visual density to speed up chart rendering. Metrics (p50/p95) use full-data aggregates unless you enable 'Lower metrics precision.'\" Option B (short): \"Sampling reduces trace density for smoother charts. Metrics remain full-accuracy unless 'Lower metrics precision' is enabled.\" prefer B for compact UI.

drew.a11y: edits to the copy: replace \"Lower metrics precision\" with that exact phrase in the switch label (consistency). add an aria-describedby on the switch pointing to the help text id. for the slider, add `aria-valuemin=\"5\"`, `aria-valuemax=\"100\"`, and `aria-live=\"polite\"` for value announcements. flyout menu items should use role=menuitemcheckbox.

neha.eng: dev feasibility: the funnel+flyout is straightforward. we can keep storage global by default and opt into per-chart storage behind `feature:per_chart_sampling`. prototype will keep slider step=5. note: the slider thumb animation currently causes repainting of the heatmap layer; we'll throttle with requestAnimationFrame.

oliver.design: good call. also added a small breadcrumb in the flyout: \"Applies to: Heatmap\" so it's explicit. mock updated here: https://tiny.redwood/mock-heatmap-funnel :eyes:

drew.a11y: one more visual a11y nit: when sampling is active, don't rely solely on color to indicate state. add an icon + textual state (e.g., \"Sampling: On\"). ensure tap targets >= 44px.

neha.eng: noted. style change: expose CSS var `--badge-p95-color` so product can tweak contrast quickly. i'll switch to #9b7ef0 as a better contrast on dark.

rachel.pm: telemetry requirements: events: `sampling.toggled`, `sampling.scope` (global|chart), `sampling.rate`, `sampling.changed_via` (ui|api). docs: add a note to dashboard migration guide. ship behind feature flag and enable for a small canary.

oliver.design: timeline: i'll update the component spec & new mock with shorter microcopy and the a11y checklist. plan to iterate after perf results.

ui-bot: created ticket #4301 - \"Hybrid funnel flyout for chart sampling + accessibility checklist\" assigned to neha.eng, due 2024-06-10.
